title: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
summary: Hundreds of stores were targeted by the overnight hack, which spoiled fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.

overrides.data_affected: Refrigeration / OT control systems (no customer data reported stolen)
overrides.impact: Hundreds of supermarket branches; fresh and frozen stock worth millions of euros spoiled.
overrides.prevention: Segment OT/IoT networks from corporate IT, disable default remote maintenance access, and monitor industrial controllers for anomalous commands.

title: FBI Says North Korean Hackers Stole Over $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls
summary: State-backed operators impersonated executives on deepfake video calls to trick employees into approving fraudulent cryptocurrency transfers worth hundreds of millions of dollars.

overrides.impact: Over $400 million in crypto stolen from exchanges and funds via social engineering.
overrides.prevention: Verify high-value transfer requests out-of-band, require dual authorization, and train staff to treat unexpected video calls as untrusted.

title: SilentAir Hijacks Asian Telecom Networks to Intercept SMS 2FA Codes and Spy on Taiwanese Users
summary: A stealthy group compromised telecom infrastructure to intercept SMS one-time codes, defeating 2FA and enabling surveillance of targeted users.

overrides.data_affected: SMS one-time codes, 2FA tokens and private communications
overrides.impact: Telecom networks hijacked to intercept 2FA codes and spy on targeted Taiwanese users.
overrides.prevention: Replace SMS 2FA with phishing-resistant (FIDO2) MFA, and harden and monitor signalling (SS7/Diameter) interconnects.

title: Operation Endgame Takes Down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC Servers, Seizes 6.4M Stolen Logins
summary: An international law-enforcement operation dismantled malware infrastructure and recovered millions of stolen credentials harvested by info-stealers.

overrides.data_affected: 6.4 million stolen logins and session tokens
overrides.impact: Info-stealer botnets (Gootloader, CastleRAT, StealC) seized; 6.4M credentials recovered.
overrides.prevention: Rotate credentials exposed to info-stealers, enforce MFA everywhere, and block execution of unsigned loaders on endpoints.

title: Trezor Confirms Hidden Implants in Resold Wallets That Can Steal Recovery Phrases
summary: Tampered hardware wallets sold through a third-party reseller contained hidden implants capable of exfiltrating users' recovery phrases.

overrides.data_affected: Cryptocurrency wallet recovery phrases / private keys
overrides.impact: Resold hardware wallets carried implants able to steal recovery phrases and drain funds.
overrides.prevention: Buy hardware wallets only from the vendor or authorised sellers, verify tamper-evidence and firmware signatures before first use.

title: British Library knocked offline for months by ransomware attack
summary: A ransomware gang stole and leaked internal data and crippled online systems at the UK's national library, with recovery stretching over many months.

overrides.data_affected: Internal HR data and user records; catalogue and online services
overrides.impact: The national library's digital services were down for months; stolen data was leaked.
overrides.prevention: Enforce MFA on all remote access, keep offline tested backups, and segment legacy systems to limit ransomware spread.

title: Colonial Pipeline shut down by ransomware, triggering fuel shortages
summary: A ransomware attack forced the largest US fuel pipeline offline, causing panic buying and fuel shortages across the US East Coast; a ransom was paid.

overrides.data_affected: Billing/IT systems; operational pipeline controls shut down precautionarily
overrides.impact: Largest US fuel pipeline halted; fuel shortages and panic buying across the East Coast.
overrides.prevention: Isolate IT from OT networks, retire shared/legacy VPN accounts, and enforce MFA on all remote access.

title: SolarWinds supply-chain hack breaches US government networks
summary: Attackers inserted a backdoor into widely-used network-management software, compromising numerous US government agencies and companies in a stealthy espionage campaign.

overrides.data_affected: Government and corporate email and internal systems
overrides.impact: Thousands of organisations ran the trojanised update; multiple US agencies were breached.
overrides.prevention: Verify build integrity and code signing, generate SBOMs, isolate build pipelines, and monitor for anomalous outbound traffic.

title: Change Healthcare ransomware attack disrupts US medical billing nationwide
summary: A ransomware attack on a major health-tech processor disrupted prescriptions and insurance claims across the US and exposed the health data of a vast number of people.

overrides.data_affected: Health/medical records and insurance claims data of millions of people
overrides.impact: Nationwide disruption to prescriptions, claims and payments across US healthcare.
overrides.prevention: Enforce MFA on remote access (the initial entry point), segment critical systems, and keep offline backups and a tested recovery plan.

title: MOVEit vulnerability triggers mass data breach across hundreds of organisations
summary: Attackers exploited a zero-day flaw in the MOVEit file-transfer tool to steal data from hundreds of companies and government bodies, affecting tens of millions of people.

overrides.data_affected: Personal records of tens of millions across many organisations
overrides.impact: Hundreds of organisations breached through a single file-transfer zero-day.
overrides.prevention: Patch internet-facing software immediately on disclosure, apply virtual patching/WAF rules, and minimise data retained in transfer tools.

title: Cyberattack cuts power to hundreds of thousands in Ukraine
summary: Attackers remotely tripped breakers at electricity distribution companies, cutting power to hundreds of thousands of people in the first known grid takedown by hackers.

overrides.data_affected: SCADA/industrial control systems of power distributors
overrides.impact: Hundreds of thousands lost power when breakers were tripped remotely.
overrides.prevention: Air-gap or strictly segment SCADA, require MFA for operator access, and retain manual failover for critical breakers.

title: Hackers hijack high-profile Twitter accounts in bitcoin scam
summary: Attackers used social engineering against staff to seize verified accounts and post a cryptocurrency scam, exposing weaknesses in internal admin tools.

overrides.data_affected: Internal admin tooling access and high-profile account credentials
overrides.impact: Dozens of verified accounts hijacked to run a bitcoin scam reaching millions of followers.
overrides.prevention: Lock down internal admin tools with least privilege and MFA, log privileged actions, and train staff against social-engineering calls.

title: The LastPass Breach, Explained: How Stolen Vaults Put Millions at Risk
summary: Attackers used stolen developer credentials to reach cloud backups and exfiltrate encrypted password vaults, leaving millions of users exposed to offline cracking.

overrides.data_affected: Encrypted password vaults, URLs and customer metadata of millions of users
overrides.impact: Millions of password vaults exfiltrated from cloud backups, enabling long-term offline cracking.
overrides.prevention: Isolate and monitor developer/cloud credentials, enforce phishing-resistant MFA on build systems, and encrypt all vault metadata at rest.
